classificationMethod: ancestor walk: any mesh under a node named Oboe_Base is body, everything under Static or Moving is keywork

goldKeyTexture.note: orphaned in the scene graph but still present in the GLB; loaded on demand via GLTFLoader's parser.getDependency for the gold key finish

modifications: Wave 2 (W2-E): the body mesh Oboe_Base_My_Oboe_0 (originally one primitive, top joint + lower joint + bell fused) was split by local Y into three primitives -- Oboe_Base_My_Oboe_0_top_joint, Oboe_Base_My_Oboe_0_lower_joint, Oboe_Base_My_Oboe_0_bell -- sharing the original POSITION/NORMAL accessors and material. No vertex, UV or normal data was added, removed or moved. See scripts/segment-model.mjs's recipe-oboe subcommand for the split method and ATTRIBUTION.md for the CC BY modification note.

Oboe_Base.note: whole wooden body, split by Y into three primitives at the two seams the mesh already has

Oboe_Base_My_Oboe_0_top_joint.note: local Y > 0.65 -- the reed-staple receiver end

Static.note: posts, pillars, screws, springs, fixed rods, thumb rest -- does not move

Moving.note: key cups + pads, moving rods/levers, bent levers, key touches -- moves with fingering
